posts.title: New dark mode theme and cute emotes everywhere!
posts.description: - Added a new dark mode theme! I don't usually prefer dark mode, but I noticed how blinding my regular theme was during night time. Now visitors have more options! My dark mode feels hauntingly like chocolates in the deep sea lol. (⌐■֊■) Your current theme is indicated by the button on the bottom right on desktop (and in the menu on mobile). Click on the theme button to cycle through each theme! A
